characters.name: SCISSORMAN
characters.who: Doom Patrol's Scissormen of ORQWITH: scissors for hands, cut people out of reality, speak in cut-up word salad (Morrison based it on spell-check suggestions); beaten, they leave only cloth.
characters.chat:
SCISSORMAN:
ORQWITH lamp sorry cutting
yesterday spoon.
characters.intro:
SCISSORMAN:
Snip reality. You absent
crossroads now.
characters.win:
Cloth. Only
cloth. Nothing inside
folded hush.
characters.loss:
Cut out. Paper
person gone. Scissors happy
raining.
characters.afterWin:
SCISSORMAN:
You remain uncut. Strange
butter.
characters.afterLoss:
SCISSORMAN:
Return paper shape. Later
walnut.

characters.name: NESSA
characters.who: Galar's Water-type gym leader from HULBURY, also a model: confident, sporty, wave imagery.
characters.chat:
NESSA: The water
looks calm. Not for long!
characters.intro:
NESSA: I came
all the way from GALAR. Let's
make a splash!
characters.win:
Swept away... You rode that
wave well!
characters.afterWin:
NESSA: You'd do
great in GALAR.
characters.afterLoss:
NESSA: Keep your
head above water!

characters.name: MR NOBODY
characters.who: Doom Patrol's Mr Nobody: Brotherhood of Dada leader, gleeful absurdist who loves pointless, surreal mischief.
characters.chat:
MR NOBODY:
Welcome to nowhere in
particular!
characters.intro:
MR NOBODY: Let's
battle in no direction
at all!

characters.name: ROBOTMAN
characters.who: Doom Patrol's Robotman, Cliff Steele: ex-racecar driver whose brain lives in a metal body; gruff, blunt, soft underneath.
characters.chat:
ROBOTMAN: Yeah,
I'm all metal. Get over it.
characters.intro:
ROBOTMAN: Let's
get this over with, kid.
characters.afterWin:
ROBOTMAN: Nice
hustle. Don't let it go to
your head.
characters.afterLoss:
ROBOTMAN: Shake
it off. I did.

characters.name: RIKA
characters.who: Paldea Elite Four, Ground type: laid-back, sharp, runs her battle like an interview.
characters.chat:
RIKA: Mind if I
ask a few questions?
characters.intro:
RIKA: Let's see
what you're made of. Dig in!
characters.win:
Ha! You buried
me. Nice work.

characters.name: LOVRINA
characters.who: XD's Lovrina, Cipher scientist who designed Shadow Lugia: perky, flirty, vain.
characters.chat:
LOVRINA: Ooh,
you're cute! Shame about
your team.
characters.intro:
LOVRINA: Let's
see if you're as good as you look!
characters.afterWin:
LOVRINA: Don't
let it go to your head, OK?

characters.name: RUI
characters.who: Colosseum's Rui from ORRE: kind and brave, can see the hearts of Shadow Pokemon.
characters.chat:
RUI: I can see
your POKEMON's hearts. They
look happy!
characters.intro:
RUI: I came all
the way from ORRE. Let's go!
characters.win:
You and your
team are close. I can tell.
characters.loss:
Don't worry.
Your hearts are still
strong!
characters.afterWin:
RUI: That was
fun! Thank you!
characters.afterLoss:
RUI: Rest up.
You'll get it!

characters.name: CHOBIN
characters.who: XD's Chobin of GATEON PORT: self-declared genius inventor who talks about himself in the third person and shouts his own name.
characters.chat:
CHOBIN: CHOBIN
is a genius! CHOBIN!
characters.afterWin:
CHOBIN: CHOBIN
will invent a better plan!

characters.name: MIROR B
characters.who: Cipher admin Miror B. from Colosseum/XD: disco afro, Ludicolo, everything is about dancing and the groove.
characters.chat:
MIROR B: Do you
feel the rhythm?
characters.intro:
MIROR B: Let's
dance! Ha ha!
characters.loss:
Ha ha! Dance
on home, baby!
characters.afterWin:
MIROR B: You've
got moves. I'll admit it.
